environment.success_rule: existing criterion: lift >=0.10m sustained for >=5 control steps

noise_algorithm: For each episode, initialize numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence([noise_generation_seed, evaluation_seed]))); draw standard_normal((161,2)) as float32 once. Array row t is the absolute environment control-step t XY standard-normal pair, independent of policy inference calls. Multiply the same base array by sigma in meters for applied errors. R1/R4 and all sigma levels therefore share the same base noise at each (evaluation_seed, control_step).
